{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to ensure we keep the highest sample_seq
df_sorted = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the first (highest sample_seq)
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now filter for control arm and moderate severity
control_moderate_dedup = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the result
print(f"Control-arm, moderate-severity patients after deduplication: {len(control_moderate_dedup)}")
print(f"Responded count after deduplication: {control_moderate_dedup['responded'].sum()} out of {len(control_moderate_dedup)}")

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = control_moderate_dedup['responded'].mean()
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
